title: Movie Night at the Largest Municipal Pool in the United States
description:
Movie night makes a splash at the Hansen Dam Aquatic Center! Families gathered for an evening of swimming, entertainment, food trucks, community resources, giveaways, and a movie under the stars—all from the water.

With dedicated areas for young children, teenagers, and adults, the Aquatic Center offers plenty of space for swimmers of all ages and abilities. Lifeguards are stationed throughout the facility to help families enjoy the water safely.

Located in the San Fernando Valley, Hansen Dam Aquatic Center provides an affordable way to cool off, spend time together, and create lasting summer memories—without the traffic or parking costs of a trip to the beach.

Plan your visit to Hansen Dam Aquatic Center located at:
11798 Foothill Blvd, Lake View Terrace, CA 91342 
https://recreation.parks.lacity.gov/aquatic/year-round/hansen
